voice_label: Evening Shift synthetic cast (Dale = Kinski synthetic parody; fictional CC0-based waitress and evening host)
scope: 109 unique clean takes for unreal/Narrative/EveningShift: 56 DALE, 43 WAITRESS, 10 RADIO_HOST. D61_FIXED_FRAGMENT_001 reuses D01_HANDOVER_001 (recording_aliases); no new take. The pack has no WARD or ATTENDANT cues.

model.name: k2-fsa/OmniVoice
model.license_reason_from_model_card: Constraints from training data, e.g. Emilia
model.license_statement: Downloaded model card: code Apache-2.0; pre-trained model CC-BY-NC because of training-data constraints.

request_settings.effect_preset: broadcast (documented VoiceStudio default, same as the Kinski corpus: 80 Hz highpass, compressor, mild shelf EQ, limiter; a studio mastering chain, not a phone/radio channel filter)
request_settings.seed_policy: 42 for every take; a broken take may be regenerated with the next seed, logged in retakes.json

DALE.voice_profile_origin: Original Klaus Kinski argument with Walter Saxer on the Fitzcarraldo set, reproduced in Werner Herzog's documentary Mein liebster Feind (1999). A locally selected 6.25-second excerpt conditions the synthetic parody voice; the original recording is not bundled.
DALE.basis: Tom's explicit instruction: same profile and settings as the existing Kinski corpus (web/production/kinski/provenance.json).

source_recording.license: CC0-1.0 as explicitly stated for voice-donations in the pinned repository README
source_recording.method: 40ms autocorrelation, RMS gate .015, lag40-230 at16k, normalized correlation >.5. Register estimate only; octave errors possible. Not age/gender verification.
source_recording.conditioning_text: It says it's the last 10 seconds, and if that's the case, and I'd shut up previously, there would just be 10 seconds.

WAITRESS.basis: No existing waitress profile. Unnamed CC0 'woman caller' profile from the radiocast bank; see casting.json.

source_recording.license: CC0-1.0 as explicitly stated for voice-donations in the pinned repository README
source_recording.method: 40ms autocorrelation, RMS gate .015, lag40-230 at16k, normalized correlation >.5. Register estimate only; octave errors possible. Not age/gender verification.
source_recording.conditioning_text: It's about 15 degrees, it's raining, very cozy, a great day to hack, and I can't wait to hear my voice cloned.

RADIO_HOST.basis: No existing evening-host profile. Unnamed CC0 'old caller' profile; not Earl (494881fc) and not Kinski; see casting.json.

licence_notes: OmniVoice code is Apache-2.0; the downloaded model card states CC-BY-NC for the pre-trained weights because of training-data constraints (e.g. Emilia). CC0 source audio does not lift that restriction.
Kinski reference: a short excerpt from a copyrighted documentary; synthetic parody, no licence, consent or endorsement claimed. Original not bundled.
Kyutai voice-donations (Selfie.wav, oldNerd.wav) are CC0-1.0 as stated in the pinned repository README; donor gender, age and accent are not verified.
Source recordings, reference WAVs, model weights, profile paths and the local API are build-time only and are not committed or shipped.
postprocessing: Raw 24 kHz model output trimmed to detected speech (-45 dBFS, 10 ms blocks) plus 80 ms lead / up to 200 ms tail, resampled to 48 kHz with soxr, one constant gain toward -20 dBFS active RMS (-50 dBFS 20 ms gate, the Kinski corpus target) capped at -2 dBFS sample peak, 10 ms fade-in / 30 ms fade-out inside the pads, PCM16 mono WAV without metadata. No compression, pitch shift, time stretch or channel filter in post.
runtime_assets: Clean WAV takes only, outside Git (see README). The game applies the phone/walkie/radio filter at playback.
